name: institutional_flow_momentum_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus
thesis: Large individual bar volume spikes (>5x SMA(volume,20)) that move price by >0.2% in one direction likely represent institutional block execution or large algo orders. These create temporary momentum because: (1) the large order itself moves the price, (2) other algos detect the large print and follow (momentum ignition), (3) the institutional trader likely has more volume to execute after the initial block. The edge exists because detecting these volume spikes in real-time and acting within 1-2 bars captures the follow-through momentum before it dissipates. The inefficiency persists because distinguishing a genuine institutional block from a large retail order or ETF creation/redemption is difficult — we use the combination of volume spike + price impact + VWAP direction as a proxy.

long.confirmation: next bar after spike also closes green (follow-through buying)

short.confirmation: next bar after spike also closes red (follow-through selling)

entry.entry_price: market order on follow-through bar close (2nd bar after initial spike)

exit.stop_loss: 0.2% from entry OR price crosses back to the open of the spike bar (impact fully reversed)
exit.signal_exit: exit if a reverse vol_spike > 5x occurs in opposite direction (counter-block)

filters.vix_filter: no specific filter — institutional flows occur regardless of VIX
filters.volume_filter: vol_spike > 5x is the core filter (very strict)
filters.trend_filter: VWAP direction should confirm the spike direction
filters.event_filter: check if spike coincides with index move — if yes, it is macro-driven, not stock-specific flow
other_filters: ignore spikes in first 5 min (opening auction distortion) and last 10 min (closing auction)

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — volume spike detection is simple but distinguishing institutional from noise requires judgment

weaknesses: Not all volume spikes are institutional — could be ETF rebalancing, bulk deal, or single large retail order
The 5x volume threshold is very strict, reducing trade frequency to 1-2 per day across the universe
Entry is 2 bars after the spike — by then, initial price impact may have already decayed, entering after the best move
prior_art: Institutional flow detection: Kyle (1985) informed trading model. Volume spike analysis: Karpoff (1987) 'Relation Between Price Changes and Trading Volume'. Momentum ignition: Brogaard et al. (2014) 'High-Frequency Trading and Price Discovery'. The specific 5x volume threshold with price-impact filter is a practical adaptation of these concepts.
notes: Edge math: 0.52 * 40bps - 0.48 * 25bps = 20.8 - 12.0 = 8.8 bps gross. Costs ~11 bps. Net ≈ -2.2 bps. Marginally negative. If follow-through bar has strong candle pattern (marubozu), win rate may push to 0.56: 0.56*40 - 0.44*25 = 22.4 - 11 = 11.4 bps gross, net ~0.4 bps. Borderline. Best used as an alert/screening signal to feed into a manual discretionary framework.
